_comment: Azure Portal Dashboard for QRForge monitoring. Import via: Portal > Dashboard > Upload > select this file. If import fails, create tiles manually using the instructions in the comments.

0._comment: TILE 1: CPU per pod — use InsightsMetrics query #1 from kql-queries.md

chart.title: CPU Utilization per Pod — QRForge Frontend

1._comment: TILE 2: Memory working set — use query #2 from kql-queries.md

2._comment: TILE 3: HTTP Request Count & P95 Latency. In Azure Portal, pin from Azure Monitor workspace (qrforge-amw) > Prometheus explorer using PromQL: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app="qrforge-frontend"}[5m])) by (le)) and sum(rate(http_requests_total{app="qrforge-frontend"}[5m])). Log Analytics placeholder included below.

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30m)
| where ObjectName == 'K8SContainer' and InstanceName endswith '/frontend'
| summarize TotalRecords = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| render timechart

inputs.name: PartTitle
inputs.value: HTTP Request Count + P95 Latency (Pin from qrforge-amw)

3._comment: TILE 4: Active replica count. Uses KubePodInventory query #4 from kql-queries.md

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
KubePodInventory
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where Namespace == 'qrforge'
| where Name startswith 'qrforge-frontend'
| where PodStatus == 'Running'
| summarize ReplicaCount = dcount(Name) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| render timechart

HOW_TO_IMPORT: 1. Azure Portal -> search 'Dashboard' in top bar
2. Click '+ Create' -> 'Upload'
3. Select this dashboard.json file
4. The dashboard renders tiles 1, 2, and 4 from Log Analytics / Monitor metrics.
HOW TO PIN TILE 3 (Prometheus P95 Latency & Request Rate):
1. Go to Azure Monitor workspaces -> select 'qrforge-amw'
2. In left sidebar under Monitoring -> select 'Prometheus explorer'
3. Paste: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app="qrforge-frontend"}[5m])) by (le))
4. Click 'Run query'
5. Click the pushpin icon 'Pin to dashboard' in top-right of chart -> select this dashboard -> click Pin.
6. (Optional) Repeat for request rate: sum(rate(http_requests_total{app="qrforge-frontend"}[5m]))
MANUAL TILE CREATION (if uploading JSON is not desired):
TILE 1 -- CPU per Pod:
Log Analytics -> Logs -> run query #1 from kql-queries.md -> Pin to dashboard
TILE 2 -- Memory Trend:
Log Analytics -> Logs -> run query #2 from kql-queries.md -> Pin to dashboard
TILE 3 -- HTTP Requests + P95 Latency:
Azure Monitor workspace (qrforge-amw) -> Prometheus explorer -> run PromQL -> Pin to dashboard
TILE 4 -- Replica Count:
Log Analytics -> Logs -> run query #4 from kql-queries.md -> Pin to dashboard
